job.title: Solutions Architect
job.description:
Shape solution architecture across a major technology transformation within the higher education sector.

We’re looking for an experienced Solution Architect to define solution designs, architecture specifications and governance artefacts across a large-scale technology modernisation program.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working across business and technical stakeholders, translating complex requirements into practical solution designs and providing the architecture that engineering, integration and delivery teams can build from.

The organisation is modernising its data environment, strengthening data governance and controls, and building the foundations to take advantage of future AI opportunities.

About the Role:
  • Translate functional and non-functional requirements into clear solution specifications and architecture designs.
  • Develop and maintain architecture documentation across application, data, integration, security and technology viewpoints.
  • Define logical integration requirements, including systems, data flows, business events, latency and failure considerations.
  • Develop identity and access architecture, including identity providers, federation, role models and conditional access requirements.
  • Prepare Architecture Decision Records, documenting options, recommendations, evidence, approvals and consequences.
  • Ensure solution designs remain aligned with governance requirements, security considerations, vendor constraints and broader architectural decisions.
  • Produce architecture artefacts to support governance, security assessments, risk reviews and project controls.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders, engineers, integration architects, security specialists and other technical teams to ensure solutions are clearly defined and fit for purpose.
  • Contribute to the ongoing modernisation of the organisation’s data and technology environment, including future data and AI capabilities.
About You:
  • Proven experience as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect or Enterprise Architect within complex technology environments.
  • Strong experience translating business and technical requirements into detailed solution designs and specifications.
  • Strong understanding of application, data, integration, security and technology architecture.
  • Experience defining integration patterns, data flows and logical integration specifications.
  • Experience with identity and access architecture, including federation, role-based access and conditional access.
  • Strong architecture documentation and governance experience, including Architecture Decision Records and formal design artefacts.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to work across business, technical and governance teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance requirements, constraints, risks and architectural considerations.
  • Experience working within enterprise, government, higher education or other large-scale transformation environments is highly desirable.
  • Experience across Microsoft, Azure, modern data platforms, data governance or Microsoft Fabric would be advantageous.
  • TOGAF or similar architecture framework experience/certification would be advantageous.
If you’re a Solution Architect looking to play a key role in a major technology transformation, shape solution design across a complex higher education environment and contribute to the foundations of future data and AI capabilities, we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: Technology Portfolio Financial Controller
job.description:

We’re looking for an experienced Financial Controller to provide financial governance, reporting, forecasting and commercial oversight across a portfolio of IT projects and programs.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working closely with Project Managers, Program Managers, PMO and Finance teams to provide meaningful financial insights, strengthen cost control and support informed investment decisions.

About the Role
  • Manage portfolio budgets, forecasts, EACs, expenditure and commitments across IT projects and programs.
  • Prepare monthly financial reporting, executive packs and variance analysis, identifying cost pressures, risks and opportunities.
  • Provide financial governance and support month-end activities, including accruals, journals, cost reallocations and maintaining accurate project financial data.
  • Partner with Project and Program Managers, Finance stakeholders and vendors on budgeting, forecasting, business cases and funding requirements.
  • Support procurement and vendor management, including purchase orders, invoices and project cost allocation.
  • Provide financial insights to support project prioritisation, investment decisions and overall portfolio performance.
  
About You
  • CA/CPA qualified, working towards qualification, or degree qualified with relevant experience.
  • Experience in project, portfolio or commercial finance within complex project environments.
  • Strong experience across budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, variance reporting and financial governance.
  • Advanced Excel skills with experience using financial, project management or reporting systems.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to communicate financial insights to senior stakeholders.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement skills and the ability to work autonomously across multiple priorities.
  • Experience in large or complex project environments is highly desirable, with PeopleSoft or project/portfolio management certification advantageous.
   
If you’re a Financial Controller looking to take ownership of portfolio financial performance and work closely with project, program and finance stakeholders within a complex technology environment, we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: RF Engineer
job.description:
About the role:
We’re searching for an experienced RF Engineer to join a highly technical communications environment supporting critical P25 radio networks across Victorian Metropolitan Mobile Radio (MMR) and Regional Mobile Radio (RMR) networks.
  
This role will provide specialist RF technical expertise across the operations, maintenance, engineering and upgrade of complex radio systems, microwave links and associated telecommunications infrastructure. You will act as a key technical escalation point for Network Operations and Field Engineering teams, providing high-level technical support and troubleshooting across critical communications infrastructure.
  
This opportunity is particularly suited to an RF Engineer with strong experience across Land Mobile Radio (LMR), RF propagation, coverage prediction and measurement, with an understanding of how radio, microwave, network and telecommunications systems operate together.
  • Permanent, full-time role
  • Up to $135,000 + Super, depending on skill and experience
  • Join a global leader in mission-critical communications and public safety technology, offering the stability and scale of an established multinational alongside genuinely meaningful work
  • Genuine opportunity to develop into a Senior Engineering Specialist / Design Authority role
  • 24x7 on-call roster with minimal ad hoc travel to metro sites

What You’ll Be Doing
  • Provide technical support and maintenance across critical P25 radio networks throughout Victoria.
  • Act as the RF SME, supporting RF coverage, propagation, microwave links and network performance.
  • Investigate and troubleshoot complex RF and communications issues, providing technical escalation to NOC and Field Engineering teams.
  • Support network testing, integration, upgrades and ongoing improvements across radio and transmission infrastructure.
  • Conduct RF measurements, coverage analysis and propagation modelling to ensure network performance and reliability.
  • Design RF site configurations, applying deep technical knowledge of antenna systems, propagation characteristics and site-specific nuances to deliver optimal network performance.
  • Conduct site surveys and spectrum analysis using industry-standard survey tools and spectrum analysers to assess RF conditions and identify potential interference.
  • Perform coverage prediction, modelling and calculations to inform network design and validate performance against real-world survey measurements.
  • Prepare clear, detailed technical reports and documentation covering RF surveys, network performance, and design recommendations for internal and customer stakeholders.
  • Support core network infrastructure including firewalls, routers, switches, microwave links, and physical/virtual servers, both remotely and onsite.
  • Develop and maintain as-built documentation, change and problem management procedures, and test protocols to support routine system maintenance.
  
What You’ll Need to Be Successful
  • Full Australian working rights
  • Tertiary Engineering qualification or strong equivalent industry experience.
  • Extensive telecommunications experience, with a strong background in RF, LMR/P25 and microwave transmission propagation.
  • Experience with RF coverage prediction, propagation modelling and real-world RF measurements.
  • Strong understanding of radio network performance, transmission links and associated infrastructure.
  • Experience using RF survey tools and spectrum test equipment, with knowledge of TSB-88 highly regarded.
  • Strong report writing and documentation skills.
  • Australian driver’s licence, willingness to travel to remote sites and participate in a 24x7 on-call roster.
  
How to Apply:
If this sounds like your kind of role, I’d love to hear from you. Click Apply or send your CV to addison@versegroup.com.au and let’s have a chat about the opportunity and what’s next!!

job.title: Business Analyst - Records Information Management
job.description:

We’re looking for an experienced Business Analyst to join a hands-on project team delivering significant change across a complex, multi-business-unit environment.
  
This is a great opportunity for a Business Analyst with strong systems implementation, process analysis and stakeholder engagement experience who enjoys working closely with business and technology teams to translate business needs into practical solutions.

You’re an experienced Business Analyst with a strong track record of working across complex transformation and systems implementation projects. You’re comfortable operating between business and technology teams and can bring structure to complex requirements, processes and stakeholder environments.
  
  • Experience delivering business analysis within complex systems implementation or transformation projects.
  • Strong business process analysis and modelling experience, including current and future-state processes.
  • Proven ability to translate business needs into functional and technical requirements.
  • Strong workshop facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to build consensus and manage competing priorities.

If you’re a Business Analyst looking for a hands-on opportunity to play a key role in a major information management transformation, we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: FIFO Communications Technicians
job.description:
We've partnered with a well-established, owner operator gold mining company operating an open pit and processing complex in the WA Goldfields region. They are building a new in-house Mining Systems and Communications team from the ground up, reducing reliance on external vendors and bringing this capability onsite for the first time.

This is a genuine opportunity to shape how communications and mining technology is delivered and supported at this site, rather than stepping into an established structure with everything already mapped out. What matters most is that you know what a good comms setup looks like on a working mine site, and that you're happy to put the documentation and processes in place yourself as you go.

About the role:
Reporting to the Mining Systems Supervisor, you'll support the installation, maintenance, and fault finding of communications infrastructure and operational technology across the site, including:
  • DMR/TETRA radio systems and mobile two-way radios across LVs and heavy mining equipment
  • LTE/5G private networks, Wi-Fi mesh, and microwave/point-to-point links
  • Fleet Management System (FMS) hardware on haul trucks, dozers, graders, loaders and drills
  • Autonomous Haulage System (AHS) communication hardware, cabling and antennas
  • CCTV systems including fixed IP cameras and PTZ units
  • Portable communications trailers and skids, including solar, battery and repeater components
  • GPS and telemetry systems
You'll also work alongside specialist vendors on more advanced rigging, tower and LTE/5G infrastructure work, with the site looking to modernise its networking hardware and standardise its radio fleet across operations.

About you:
  • Full Australian working rights - this role offers no form of Visa sponsorship or relocation assistance
  • Site startup or ramp-up experience is essential. You'll be setting a function up from nothing, so we need someone who has done this before and knows what success actually looks like on an active mine site, not just in theory
  • Comfortable and confident building documentation, processes and standards where none currently exist - this is a core part of the role, not a side task
  • Trade qualification in communications, electronics or electro-technology, or equivalent hands-on experience
  • Proven experience with two-way radio systems, mobile fleet installations and site communication infrastructure in a mining or heavy industry environment
  • Working knowledge of IP networking, wireless communications (Wi-Fi, LTE/5G) and backhaul technology
  • Current WA "C" Class driver's licence
  • Restricted Electrical Licence, Registered Cabler Licence, or exposure to AHS/autonomous mining communications will be highly regarded but are not essential
What's in it for you?
  • $145,000–$155,000 + Superannuation
  • Approximately $7,000–$8,000 in additional allowances and benefits, including the option of employer-paid health insurance or the cash equivalent
  • 8:6 roster - days only, no night shift
  • The opportunity to build a communications function from scratch and directly shape how it's run going forward
If you've stood up or ramped up a communications or mining technology function on a mine site before, and know what it takes to build documentation and standards from zero, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply now or contact Holly on 0485009838 for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Scrum Master
job.description:
Facilitate Agile delivery across a portfolio of software teams supporting a large energy company's decarbonisation goals.
 
We're looking for an experienced Scrum Master to join a leading energy organisation on a 12-month contract, supporting a software team building applications for decarbonisation, including energy balance modelling, cable management, EV charging and load forecasting.
 
The role will establish effective Agile ways of working, facilitate Scrum cadences, support prioritised backlogs, remove blockers, and help cross-functional teams deliver high-quality outcomes to key stakeholders.
 
This is a full-time or part-time (minimum 3 days/week) role based in Perth on a 12-month contract offering hybrid working arrangement (WFH).
 
About the Role:
  • Facilitate Scrum ceremonies and establish effective delivery cadences across multiple teams.
  • Coach teams, Product Owners and stakeholders in Scrum and Agile principles, roles and ways of working.
  • Assist with prioritising and maintaining a visible, refined backlog across multiple products, with clear sprint goals and a shared Definition of Done.
  • Identify and remove impediments; coordinate resolution of risks, issues and dependencies across teams.
  • Promote transparency by maintaining JIRA boards/dashboards, delivery metrics and clear progress reporting.
  • Facilitate release planning, reviews and retrospectives; track continuous improvement actions.
  • Support collaboration across technical and business teams and consistent Agile practice adoption.
About You
You're an experienced Scrum Master with a strong understanding of Agile delivery across multiple teams and products.
  • 5+ years' experience as a Scrum Master.
  • Proven experience facilitating Scrum events including sprint planning, daily scrums, sprint reviews and retrospectives.
  • Experience coaching cross-functional teams and Product Owners in Agile principles and accountabilities.
  • Strong track record establishing delivery cadences, sprint goals, backlog refinement and Definition of Done standards.
  • Experience identifying and removing impediments, managing cross-team dependencies and escalating risks.
  • Comfort working across multiple teams/products with a mix of technical and business stakeholders.
  • Experience using delivery metrics for transparent reporting on flow, progress and predictability.
  • Strong knowledge of Scrum framework, Agile principles, JIRA and Confluence.
  • A recognised Scrum Master / Agile certification (e.g. PSM I, CSM, or equivalent).
  • Experience in the energy or mining sector is beneficial, but not essential.
If you're an experienced Scrum Master with a background delivering across multi-team software portfolios, we'd like to hear from you.

job.title: Business Intelligence Data Designer and Engineer
job.description:

You Should Have
  • Strong experience delivering business intelligence and reporting solutions
  • Experience working directly with business users to gather and define reporting and data requirements
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills
  • Experience working across large and complex systems environments
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders
  • Strong analytical capability with the ability to identify improvement opportunities
  • Substantial relevant computing and technical experience
  
Technical Requirements
Must Have
  • Strong data modelling experience, including multi-dimensional and relational modelling
  • ETL development and data transformation experience
  • Power BI development experience
  • Databricks / Lakehouse platform experience
  • Strong report writing and report development capability
  • Experience planning, designing and implementing BI reporting systems
  
Key Responsibilities
  • Design, model and maintain business intelligence solutions
  • Produce reporting required by the Cyber Programme
  • Develop Power BI reporting
  • Undertake ETL design and development
  • Perform data profiling, modelling, transformation and migration across large and complex environments
  • Work within the Databricks / Lakehouse platform

How to Apply
If this opportunity resonates with you, please apply.

job.title: S26 Electrical Supervisors
job.description:

You will be responsible for leading electrical teams across a range of projects, shutdowns and maintenance activities, ensuring work is delivered safely, efficiently and to the required technical and quality standards. The role will suit experienced electrical leaders with a strong background in mining, fixed plant, HME, processing or other industrial environments.
  • Permanent, full-time FIFO opportunities
  • $92–$96/hr + super day shift | $101–$104.50/hr + super night shift
  • 2:1 / 12:9 rosters with 12–13.5 hour shifts
  • Mix of day and night shift depending on project requirements
  • Ongoing and ad hoc project opportunities across major client sites

  • Coordinate resources, labour, equipment and materials to achieve planned project outcomes
  • Provide technical leadership and mentoring to electricians and junior personnel

  • Demonstrated experience in an Electrical Supervisor, Leading Hand or Superintendent capacity

  • Strong technical knowledge of fixed plant, HME, processing or other industrial environments
  • Mining experience highly regarded, particularly Tier 1 Iron Ore operations

If this opportunity sounds interesting, please click apply or email your CV directly to me at ryan@versegroup.com.au.

For further details or enquiries, feel free to reach out directly via email or call on 0468 099 638.
